subject: Expunction request: prompt/output artifacts + residency confirmation
messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena@clearsight.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: support@clearsight.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: purge of prompts/outputs + EU residency confirmation

Hi Ben,

We need Redwood's help to permanently remove all prompt/response artifacts and associated inference logs tied to our account (ClearSight AI) going back to Jan 1, 2025. This includes:
- user-submitted prompts and generated outputs stored in prompt-output logs,
- derived embeddings & ephemeral artifacts, and
- inference request traces and KV cache records.

Two constraints:
1) Data must be scrubbed from Redwood's EU residency cluster only (we cannot accept data transfer out of eu-west-1),
2) We will need a signed confirmation of completion and a checksum or manifest showing the items removed (redacted IDs are fine).

Please advise the operational steps, estimated ETA, and any intake form we should complete. Also flag if there are any policy/retention caveats (billing/legal) that could delay full expunction.

Thanks,
Elena Costa
Head of Ops
ClearSight AI
elena@clearsight.ai


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena@clearsight.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 15:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs + EU residency confirmation

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. I opened this thread and attached our intake form to capture scope, account IDs, and whether you want full-schema artifacts removed or the prompt-output layer only. High-level workflow below; I can schedule ops to start once we have the signed intake and approval on the Mutual Action Plan (MAP).

Immediate steps (what we do):
1) Intake & scope — you complete the attached expunction_intake_form.pdf (fields: account_id, tenant_ids, date_range, retention exceptions).
2) Legal/Proc — Rishi will confirm if any outstanding billing holds or legal holds apply.
3) Ops scheduling — Marissa will schedule a destruction window in the EU cluster and take snapshots of the pre-delete manifest (read-only).
4) Execution — automated sweep removes prompt-output logs, embeddings, and inference request traces; KV caches are evicted and marked for overwrite per our EU residency settings.
5) Proof & sign-off — we provide a signed ops_execution_manifest.txt with checksums and a list of scrubbed object IDs (IDs redacted if required by you).

Estimated ETA: 3 business days from completed intake + legal sign-off; if there are any cross-region replicas we will need up to 7 business days.

Please find:
- Intake form attached (expunction_intake_form.pdf)
- MAP draft: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-expunction-plan

Next step: fill the intake and confirm you accept the MAP scope (one-line ok). I will loop Marissa once I have the intake.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Elena Costa <elena@clearsight.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs + EU residency confirmation

Following up — ops executed the sweep in eu-west-1 this morning per the intake (ticket: JIRA-5472). Summary of actions we ran: 
- Identified object set from tenant IDs provided in the intake (redacted list attached to internal manifest).
- Executed two-phase deletion: (1) logical deletion + manifest update, (2) zeroization pass to overwrite ephemeral KV entries.
- Removed prompt-output logs for the date range 2025-01-01 -> 2026-04-20.

Artifacts we are delivering:
- ops_execution_manifest.txt (attached) — includes scrubbed S3 object keys (redacted), deletion timestamps, and truncated SHA256 checksums.
- pre-delete snapshot link (read-only): https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit/clearsight/2026-04-22/manifest-5472.txt

Caveats & notes:
- Billing records and some audit logs required for internal compliance are retained for 90 days per our policy; they do not contain prompt/response content and are stored separately.
- If ClearSight requires full cryptographic destruction certificates (HSM key zeroization), that is a separate change order — we can discuss with Legal.

I ran a validation pass and confirmed object counts matched the intake report. If Elena confirms acceptance of the manifest, I will schedule final sign-off and close the ticket.

Attachments: ops_execution_manifest.txt

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Elena Costa <elena@clearsight.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2026 16:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs + EU residency confirmation

Marissa / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the manifest. I reviewed the pre-delete snapshot and the ops_execution_manifest.txt. I confirm ClearSight accepts the redacted manifest as proof of destruction and that the deletion was performed in eu-west-1.

Two small asks before closure: 
1) Please add the MAP signature (Ben) and ops sign-off (Marissa) to the manifest document and provide a time-stamped PDF receipt we can keep for our audit.
2) Rishi — did Legal flag anything we should keep beyond the 90-day metadata retention?

If no other holds, consider this closed on our side once the signed receipt is uploaded.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Costa
Head of Ops, ClearSight AI
elena@clearsight.ai
